items.why: Amazon helped power the Dow's intraday gain, up 1.6% at midday per MarketWatch, as the mega-cap trade steadied ahead of Q3 earnings due Oct 29.
Bernstein pushed back on AI capex worries, reiterating an Outperform rating and $641 target; the stock is also closing in on a $4 trillion market cap for the first time in nearly a year.
Musk clarified he will own and operate the $100B-plus Terafab chip project with SpaceX, while Tigress reiterated a Buy and $550 target ahead of Oct 21 earnings.
Chips sold off broadly after an FT report showed OpenAI's annualized revenue running $20B below what it signaled, denting optimism about AI demand growth.

market_note: Big banks report next week as earnings season kicks into high gear.
summary: Dow up nearly 400 points with indexes on pace for weekly gains, as the tech trade steadied after Thursday's OpenAI-driven AI selloff; energy gained while telecoms fell on SpaceX's spectrum grab.
